mechanism: Prochlorperazine may impair gastrointestinal motility and absorption, potentially affecting tenofovir bioavailability; both drugs can cause CNS effects and prochlorperazine may increase risk of orthostatic hypotension in patients on antiretroviral therapy.
action: Monitor for adequate tenofovir absorption and efficacy; assess for additive CNS depression and orthostatic hypotension; consider alternative antiemetic if clinically feasible.
